welcome_message_markdown:
Welcome to CasRand Forge 🥰 This is a free and open-source community fork of NAI CasRand.

If you are new to the app, [tap here](#jump_to_settings) to configure API token and proxy settings first.

If you encounter unexpected behavior or have an improvement idea, file an issue in [the CasRand Forge repository](https://github.com/khkjdfkjhdsfakhds/CasRand-Forge). The [original project](https://github.com/Exception0x0194/NAI-Generator-Flutter) was created by Exception0x0194.
vibe_transfer_section_tip: Vibe Transfer references for V4 / V4.5. Precise Reference is below; if both are present, generation prioritizes Precise Reference.
vibe_v4_page_tip: Supports .naiv4vibe and .naiv4vibebundle files; PNG images with embedded vibe information are also supported - try [online tool](https://nai-vibe-embedder.pages.dev/)
precise_reference_page_tip: Add character, style, or character & style reference images for V4.5 models. Strength and Fidelity both default to 1.0 and use the 0.0–1.0 range.
precise_reference_add: Add Precise Reference image, or drag PNG/JPG/WebP here
precise_reference_v45_only: Precise Reference only supports V4.5 models. Select a V4.5 model in Generation Parameters first.
precise_reference_cost_notice: Anlas notice: each Precise Reference costs 5 extra Anlas per generated image. Current estimate: {reference_count} reference(s) × {n_samples} image(s) = {anlas} extra Anlas.
precise_reference_vibe_conflict_notice: Precise Reference is incompatible with Vibe Transfer; generation will prioritize Precise Reference and skip Vibe Transfer above.
output_file_name_prefix_hint:
Use `__key__` to import prompt content in file name

E.g. `portrait-__artstyle__` → `portrait-watercolor`
title: Title
saved_config_list_usage_tip: Use `__title between double underscores__` to use saved configs here
config_selection_page_hint: Tap & hold saved config to load
restore_initial_settings_hint: Restore the active configuration to the built-in defaults
restore_initial_settings_warning: The current prompts, characters, negative prompts, generation parameters, I2I, Vibe Transfer, and software options will be restored to their initial settings. Existing entries under Saved Configs will not be deleted or overwritten. Would you like to back up the current configuration first?
i2i_drop_hint: Tap to import, or drag and drop an image here
i2i_active_note: While a base image is set, every generation uses img2img / inpainting.
i2i_generate_once_started: Generation started. Check the Generation page for the result.
inpaint_mask_present: Mask painted: masked area will be repainted
inpaint_add_original_image_hint: Keep unmasked areas identical to the original image
inpaint_autocrop_hint_on: Frames focus inpainting for you: takes the largest frame centered on the mask, scales it to fill the request budget, then scales the result back and pastes it into the original
inpaint_autocrop_hint_off: Off: the whole image is scaled to the request size and repainted directly
api_tokens_manage_hint: Add multiple NovelAI accounts' tokens; generation runs one parallel worker per enabled token.
api_tokens_empty_note: No token entries: the API key above is used alone.
api_tokens_concurrent_note: Each enabled token generates in parallel
i2i_page_sections_hint: This page also covers inpainting: import a base image, then paint a mask under Inpaint below.
enhance_section_hint: Re-render the whole base image with the official Enhance settings (1x refine or 1.5x magnification).
enhance_started: Enhance started at {size}. Check the Generation page for the result.
enhance_clears_mask_notice: Enhance re-renders the whole image, so the current mask will be cleared.
enhance_too_large: The base image is too large for any Enhance amount.
action_use_as_base_done: Loaded as the Img2Img base image.
action_inpaint_done: Loaded for inpainting. Paint a mask to continue.
action_enhance_done: Sent to Enhance with the same prompt and seed.
director_tool_hint: Single-image tools, independent of the generation pipeline. Import a source image to begin.
director_tool_started: Running {tool}. Check the Generation page for the result.
director_tool_cost_value: This run costs about {anlas} Anlas. Background removal is the most expensive tool; cost scales with image size and Opus grants no free allowance here.
i2i_sections_locked: Import a base image to unlock
i2i_sections_locked_hint: Img2Img parameters, Inpaint and Enhance all work on the base image above.
